events.title: Cayucos Farmers Market
events.window: Every Friday, 10am to 12:30pm, Memorial Day through Labor Day (through Sept 7, 2026)
events.venue: Corner of D Street & Ocean Avenue, Downtown Cayucos
events.summary: Local farmers, ranchers, bakers & food vendors fill downtown Cayucos every summer Friday morning. Free to browse; great eats steps from the pier.

events.title: Schooners Beachside Live Summer Concert Series
events.window: Sundays during summer 2026, through Labor Day weekend
events.summary: Free outdoor Sunday concerts on the beach at Schooners featuring house bands, local talent, and touring artists. 2026 lineup confirmed.

events.title: Schooners Open Mic Night
events.summary: Weekly open mic every Wednesday at Schooners — drop in and take the stage or enjoy local performers at this beachside Cayucos staple.

events.title: ECOSLO Cayucos Beach Cleanup
events.summary: Volunteer beach cleanup targeting peak-season litter along the Cayucos shoreline. Part of ECOSLO's 2026 four-cleanup series at this location.

events.title: Cayucos Antique Street Faire — Fall Edition
events.venue: N. Ocean Avenue (Cayucos Drive to E Street), Cayucos
events.summary: Over 100 antique, vintage & collectibles vendors line Ocean Ave from 7am–3pm. Food court at N. Ocean & D St. Fall 2026 applications now open.

events.title: 35th Annual Cayucos Car Show
events.summary: Classic cars fill downtown Cayucos 8am–4pm, plus a live band, beer garden & Lions Club BBQ. Check-in party Fri Nov 6 at Nelson's Garage.
